# Threxa

> Threxa ERP is an ERP for corrugated box manufacturers and other factories that run on inventory. Built and supported in Bengaluru, India, by Threxa, a unit of The Ingredient List.

Threxa ERP covers reel and paper stock by GSM and BF, work orders and job cards that follow each job through corrugation, printing, die cutting and pasting, machine-wise production tracking, wastage recorded at every stage, quotations calculated from board grade and box dimensions, GST invoices, delivery challans and e-way bills, a driver dispatch app with delivery photos, attendance, payroll and cash book. Shop-floor screens run on a phone in Kannada, Hindi and Tamil. It works alongside Tally; the Plant plan adds two-way Tally sync.

Pricing (excluding 18% GST): Shop Floor ₹12,000/month + ₹60,000 setup; Factory ₹28,000/month + ₹1,00,000 setup; Plant ₹55,000/month + ₹2,00,000 setup. Individual modules from ₹2,500/month. Setup includes an on-site visit, configuration, data loading and on-site training.
